name: Tandem Health
description: Tandem Health develops AI tools that support clinical documentation, coding, decision support, and follow-up across healthcare workflows.
long_description: Tandem Health develops AI tools that support clinical documentation, coding, decision support, and follow-up across healthcare workflows. Its AI Medical Scribe captures conversations during patient visits and converts relevant information into structured clinical notes, referrals, summaries, and other documents for review. The platform also provides suggested diagnosis and procedure codes and allows clinicians to edit documentation through voice commands. Tandem Health integrates with medical record, dental, pharmacy, and care-management systems, enabling approved notes and related documents to transfer directly into existing records. Its solutions support healthcare professionals across medical, nursing, physiotherapy, dental, mental health, social care, and veterinary settings.
industries: Artificial Intelligence (AI); Document Preparation; Health Care; Office Administration; SaaS

name: Synapath
description: Synapath AI sells hardware-agnostic robot training data, extracted from human-activity video, to robotics and embodied-AI developers.
long_description: Synapath AI (枢途科技) runs the SynaData pipeline. It turns human-activity video and multimodal data (egocentric, exocentric and tactile) into structured, hardware-agnostic training data for humanoids, dexterous hands and industrial arms. In April 2026 it open-sourced HORA, a dataset of over 150,000 trajectories with roughly ±0.5cm accuracy. It sells datasets and data delivery to robotics and embodied-AI model developers, and it describes itself as an NVIDIA ecosystem partner. It closed an angel round of nearly 100 million yuan in 2026, and PitchBook lists a $14.9M early-stage round in September 2026.
industries: Robotics; Embodied AI; AI Training Data; Physical AI; Data Infrastructure
